intro: Flintrock Falls is a gated golf community in the Lakeway 78738 area, built around a Nicklaus designed course. CleanzATX cleans windows for the newer custom homes here, and you work with Tyler directly from quote to touch up.

sections.h2: What Flintrock Falls homes are like
paragraphs: Flintrock Falls has several hundred homes behind a gate, with the Nicklaus designed Flintrock Falls course as the centerpiece. Most of the housing is newer custom construction, in the 3,000 to 6,000 square foot range, with prices from about $1M to $3M. Membership is shared with The Hills, so the two communities feel connected even though each has its own character. Owners here tend to have large rear elevations built to look out over the fairways, with tall sliders, picture windows and glass doors.

The lots roll with the Hill Country terrain, and many homes sit on a rise with a view down a fairway. Landscaping is groomed and tends to be young enough that trees have not yet crowded the walls. Stone, stucco and metal roofs show up often. All of that glass is the reason window cleaning is a regular chore, not an occasional one.

sections.h2: What Flintrock Falls windows deal with
paragraphs: Fairway glass takes a beating from irrigation. When the sprinklers sweep toward a house, they leave a fine pattern of white mineral dots that bake on in summer sun. Left alone, those dots can etch into the glass. We use a dual RO, 4 stage pure water system with a DI resin tank, so water is near 0 TDS and the glass dries clean. Pollen is the other regular visitor, with cedar from December to February and live oak in March and April coating the sills and screens.

Newer builds also bring construction dust and stucco residue, especially in the first year. West facing glass on the back of the house shows every streak in late sun, so we finish edges and corners carefully. Screens are $5 each, tracks are $5, and hard water removal is $10 per pane for any glass that needs more than a rinse.

Flintrock Falls is gated, so send us your address and any gate instructions by text before the visit. The Flintrock Falls HOA sets the rules for the community, and we keep our truck and hoses tidy and out of the way. Our 8 ft skid carries 200 gallons of water into Flintrock Falls, so we do not use your spigot. Because Flintrock and The Hills sit close together, we often schedule neighbors on the same day, which helps us book you within about two weeks. Exterior windows pair well with a patio and pool deck cleaning done by hand, so the deck does not get soaked.

For a 4,500 sq ft home in Flintrock Falls, exterior windows come to about $450 at $0.10 per sq ft. We plan about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft outside, so expect roughly four hours, and about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft if you add the inside. The minimum job is $200.

why: Fairway facing glass gets pure water that resists sprinkler spotting and dries without film.
Newer custom homes mean large panes, and we have the poles to reach them safely.
We schedule Flintrock and The Hills neighbors together, which keeps lead time short.
Patios and pool decks are cleaned by hand so your outdoor space stays dry.

faq.q: Is Flintrock Falls the same as The Hills?
faq.a: They are separate gated communities in the same 78738 area, with shared membership. We serve both and often book them on the same route.

faq.q: How do you handle the gate?
faq.a: Text us the address and your gate process. We will arrive on a day we agreed on and check in as a guest, so you do not have to be there to let us in.

faq.q: Will you clean the glass doors and tall sliders?
faq.a: Yes. Exterior glass is cleaned with water fed poles up to three stories. Interior glass is done by hand with squeegees, and we use drop cloths so floors stay clean.

faq.q: Do you do roof or house washing in Flintrock Falls?
faq.a: Yes. House soft wash starts at $0.20 per sq ft and roof soft wash at $0.25 per sq ft, each with a $400 minimum. We never pressure wash limestone, only soft wash.
Lead time for Flintrock Falls is usually within two weeks. We send quotes by text, usually inside the hour during business hours, and then pick a day that works for you.
